mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_institutions ( id, institution_code, name, business_number, representative_name, address, contact_phone, contact_email, status, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{institutionCode}, #{name}, #{businessNumber}, #{representativeName}, #{address}, #{contactPhone}, #{contactEmail}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{deletedAt, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP_WITH_TIMEZONE} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, institution_code, name, business_number, representative_name, address, contact_phone, contact_email, status, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at FROM tb_institutions WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, institution_code, name, business_number, representative_name, address, contact_phone, contact_email, status, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at FROM tb_institutions WHERE institution_code = #{institutionCode} AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT id, institution_code, name, business_number, representative_name, address, contact_phone, contact_email, status, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at FROM tb_institutions WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_institutions WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_institutions SET institution_code = #{institutionCode}, name = #{name}, business_number = #{businessNumber}, representative_name = #{representativeName}, address = #{address}, contact_phone = #{contactPhone}, contact_email = #{contactEmail}, status = #{status}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
